$schema_note: Known virtual camera fingerprints used by audit-virtualcam.sh on macOS. name_patterns are case-insensitive substrings matched against AVFoundation device names and CMIO object names (V1); bundle_ids are matched against camera-extension registrations and DAL bundle identifiers (V2/V9); file_patterns are matched against installed DAL plugin file names and bundle contents (V8); signature records what codesign -dv reports for the installed bundles (V5, informational).

file_patterns.product: OBS Studio (mac virtualcam DAL plugin file)
generic virtual camera DAL plugin file

signature.note: codesign -dv output recorded verbatim; an ad-hoc ('linker-signed') signature on the camera extension is the documented residual tell of an unsigned build and degrades V5 to WARN, not FAIL.
